stages.goal: Establish the requested entity, quantity, population, timeframe, and invariants.
Choose the primary analytical family without letting optional recovery skills redefine the question.
Obtain direct scoped machine evidence for the requested quantity.
Resolve the current evidence gap using the best still-useful capability.
Require materially independent, consistent support for a candidate.

recovery_capabilities.name: semantic_field_review
recovery_capabilities.description: Test whether the current field or representation matches the concept requested by the question.

recovery_capabilities.name: schema_inspection
recovery_capabilities.description: Inspect relevant fields or representative events without changing the current population.

recovery_capabilities.name: alternative_aggregation
recovery_capabilities.description: Calculate the requested quantity by a materially different same-scope method.

recovery_capabilities.name: temporal_pattern_analysis
recovery_capabilities.description: Use deterministic time-series and diversity analysis when temporal behaviour can reduce ambiguity.

recovery_capabilities.name: relationship_analysis
recovery_capabilities.description: Examine entity/resource relationships that can distinguish hypotheses while preserving population scope.

recovery_capabilities.name: scope_expansion
recovery_capabilities.description: Broaden population or source only after same-scope routes are exhausted or declared irrelevant and the change is independently justified.
